en.title: T
en.summary: The letter T is the twentieth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter te
paragraphs: The letter is named /t/, that is a plain t sound. Its main sound is heard in (tren) /tata/, which means father, dad. This letter has two different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch the back of your upper teeth with your tongue tip. Release the air sharply without voice. For the soft variant, make this same touch while raising your tongue body toward the roof of your mouth. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel only a tiny puff of air.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In almost all positions, this letter makes the sound /t/, that is a plain t sound, as in (tată) /ˈta.tə/. At the end of a word before short final i, it makes the sound /tʲ/, that is a soft t sound, as in (băieți) /bəˈjetsʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not puff out a heavy breath like in the English word tea. Keep the release dry and crisp. Also, do not place your tongue behind your teeth on the gum ridge as in table. Press the tongue tip directly against the back of your top front teeth.
